title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
author: Edmund Underhill
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
